reasons: Short standard setup that the build depends on.

terms.meaning: A tool that processes CSS through a list of plugins before the browser uses it.
A plugin that adds browser-specific CSS prefixes so styles work across browsers.

sections.name: default export
sections.title: Style processing steps
sections.what: Lists the two processing steps the build runs on styles: Tailwind and Autoprefixer.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the standard tools that generate the class styles and add browser prefixes.
sections.watch_out: Removing either step silently stops the matching styles from working.

summary: Tells the build to run Tailwind, which generates styles, and Autoprefixer, which adds browser-specific prefixes, on the stylesheets.
purpose: Turns on the Tailwind style system during the build.
why: Standard way to connect Tailwind to Vite. Reason stated only by convention.
how: It exports a list of two processing steps: one for Tailwind and one for Autoprefixer.
inputs: The stylesheets and the class names used in the code.
outputs: Final CSS with Tailwind classes turned into real styles and browser prefixes added.
risks: Removing either step silently breaks styles. Tailwind class names would then appear in the page with no effect.
debug: If classes have no effect, check this file and whether the Tailwind content paths include the file that uses them.
